source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Once per turn, during the Fight phase, you may use this ability after an enemy unit has finished resolving its attacks against this unit. This unit then becomes **eligible to fight**, even though it may have fought already this phase. It must also be the next unit **selected to fight**.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
